goal: Create scripts/bench_append.py, which appends one CSV result row to the first table of Benchmark/model-comparison.md with a dated tag.
requirements: Usage: python scripts/bench_append.py <csv_path> --date YYYY-MM-DD [--dry-run]. Read the CSV with the csv module: the header row, then one data row.

Set the first cell to ' (tested )', where tag is the original first cell. Escape each cell: each pipe character gets a backslash in front, and newlines become
.
Insert the new row after the last data row of the first table whose header starts with '| Model / run tag'. Change no other line of Benchmark/model-comparison.md.
A duplicate tag and date exits 1 with a message on stderr. --dry-run prints the new row to stdout and writes nothing. On success print 'appended <tag> to Benchmark/model-comparison.md'.
Write atomically: a temp file in the same folder, then os.replace. Stdlib only.
context: Python 3.11. The first cell of the data row is the tag.
